title: Claude Clears Your Inbox Automatically Every Morning
description:
Comment "INBOX" and I'll send you the prompt.

Claude can now clear your inbox automatically every morning before you wake up.

Connect Gmail in Cowork settings, schedule a task at 7 AM, paste the prompt. Claude scans unread emails, flags the urgent ones, drafts replies in your voice.

You just hit send.

#claudeai #aitools #aiproductivity #aitok #aiautomation
